dish.title: South Indian Vegetable Sambar with Toor Dal and Steamed Rice
dish.description: Toor dal simmered soft with turmeric, then cooked with carrots, eggplant, shallots, and tomatoes in a tangy tamarind broth seasoned with coriander and chili powder, finished with a sizzling tempering of mustard seeds, cumin seeds, dried chiles, and curry leaves, and served over basmati rice with cilantro.

recipe_version.title: South Indian Vegetable Sambar with Toor Dal and Steamed Rice
recipe_version.description: Toor dal simmered soft with turmeric, then cooked with carrots, eggplant, shallots, and tomatoes in a tangy tamarind broth seasoned with coriander and chili powder, finished with a sizzling tempering of mustard seeds, cumin seeds, dried chiles, and curry leaves, and served over basmati rice with cilantro.

ingredients.name: tamarind concentrate
ingredients.display_name: tamarind concentrate whose label lists tamarind and water only

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the dal and the rice separately in the strainer until the rinse runs clear. Cut the carrots into 1-inch pieces and the eggplant into 1-inch cubes, halve the shallots, chop the tomatoes, and chop the cilantro.

steps.title: Simmer the dal
steps.body: Put the dal, 3 cups water, and the turmeric in a 4-quart pot. Bring to a boil over high, about 6 minutes, skim off the foam, then partly cover and simmer, stirring now and then, until the dal is completely soft, about 30 minutes. Whisk it to a rough puree.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: While the dal simmers (overlap stated): combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes. Leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.body: Add the carrots, eggplant, shallots, tomatoes, 2 cups water, tamarind, coriander, chili powder, and 1 1/2 tsp salt to the dal. Bring back to a simmer, about 4 minutes, then simmer until the vegetables are tender, about 12 minutes.

steps.title: Temper
steps.body: Heat the oil in the 8-inch skillet over medium-high, about 1 minute. Add the mustard seeds; when they pop, add the cumin seeds, dried chiles, and curry leaves and let them sizzle for 30 seconds. Pour the tempering slowly into the sambar and stir.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice. Ladle the sambar into bowls beside the rice and scatter with cilantro.
